target.title: Keep legacy WhatsApp crontab lint opt-in
target.body:
## Summary
- mark `core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` default-disabled so default `doctor --lint` does not invoke the `crontab -l` probe
- preserve explicit selection through `--only core/doctor/legacy-whatsapp-crontab` and `--all`
- add selection coverage proving default lint skips the probe while selected lint reports the warning

## Public surface
- No public SDK/plugin/config contract changes.
- Default `doctor --lint` changes only by skipping this live crontab probe; `--all` and `--only` still include it.

## PR surface
- 2 files changed, +55/-0.

## Validation
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts` (60 tests)
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts` (18 tests)
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/flows/doctor-core-checks.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts`
- `node scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.mjs --check`
- `git diff --check`

## Not tested
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/commands/doctor/cron/index.test.ts` still has a Windows permission-mode assertion failure in `falls back to copy+unlink when renaming the legacy cron store fails with EXDEV` (`archiveStat.mode & 0o777` returned `0o666` instead of `0o640`). This PR does not touch cron storage implementation; focused lint-selection and core-check tests passed.
